_comment: WF-V6 per-subject turnaround contract (scripts/v6/README.md), written by gold.mjs new 2026-09-28. Vehicle author frame: nose +z, near flank +x, y up, ground y = 0, x and z centred. No regions.json: families.table = flat colours of the concept; families.body names the body family.
_note: 2026-09-29: turnaround regenerated (Gemini sheet + repairs, scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs; the previous GPT set is ../turnaround-1-gpt); per-view shift / scale / drift / holes measured on the previous images are not carried over — re-measure them on these images at the setup audit. Dropped (measured on the previous images): none present.

families._enclosedFg: off until the setup audit decides (see-through parts stay background)
families._table: 2026-09-29 (v2 concept refs/light_tank.v2.png): named from the concept's foreground colour clusters >= 2 % (newsubject.mjs proposeFamilies on the v2 image) + measure.mjs sample of each part: hull, turret, hatch, track guards and grille box desert tan (lit / shade / deep shade under the guards); metal = gun, mantlet, smoke launchers, tow hooks, headlight guards, tracks, road wheels, rollers, sprocket, idler gunmetal; dark = track shadow gaps and outlines
families._viewTable: 2026-09-29: per-view colours of the families (scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs families --apply; out/turnaround/light_tank/families.proposal.json): each view's foreground colour clusters (>= 1 %) matched to the table's families with ONE per-view colour offset (side -1.4 -1.9 -4.2 · front -3.3 -3.8 -4.5 · rear +8.8 +7.2 +7.4 · top -6 -6.5 -7.4); ambiguous: side #2d2b26 4.7 % dark (vs metal); front #5b4f3a 3.9 % body (vs metal); front #3a2e19 1.1 % metal (vs dark); rear #66563f 4.7 % body (vs metal); rear #4b3b22 1.6 % metal (vs dark); top #7f6c4c 6.3 % body (vs metal). Measured on these images: turnaround.mjs re-derives it for any other image set and install writes it for the installed one.

side.why: side draws the near smoke launcher as one solid slab 0.36 x 0.35 m (metal comp px 410-461 x 368-418); concept shows a 2 x 2 cluster of four open tubes angled forward-up (concept px 290-350 x 280-340)

side draws the rear wheel smooth (r 0.386 m, px 791-900 x 538-647); concept's rear wheel is toothed like the front sprocket (12 teeth, concept px 870-1000 x 455-600, tip dia ~1.14 x a road wheel) - the tooth ring is missing on the rear rim

front.why: front belly plate bottom at up 0.37 m (px 663), rear hull bottom at up 0.44 m (px 653); the concept cannot see the belly and its lower front edge is hidden by the sprocket, the rear view decides the hull bottom height

rear.why: deck grille box in rear silhouette 1.0 m wide x 0.09 m tall (body comp px 443-585 x 450-462); top view box 1.35 m across (px 415-605), side box 0.14 m tall (px 460-480): the rear draws it too narrow and too low

concept.why: hub caps drawn as upright hex nuts with their lit face pointing up (concept px 640-715 x 650-725 on road wheel 3) although they sit on the wheel face; the prompt says raised round hub caps and the side view draws round caps (px 639-664 at col 542) - the side decides the hub shape
